data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'a'raza which means 'to be strong, to be brave'. This name carries the deep significance of courage and strength, making it an excellent choice for a baby boy. The name Eiraaz carries the meaning “Strong, brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Eiraaz usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
